tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/src" && echo hi > "$t/src/a.txt"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
# backup.sh writes to dest given by --dest: verify files exist
ls "$t/dest"
echo "--- dry-run keep 2 ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dry-run --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2
echo "--- real rotate keep 2 ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2
echo "--- remaining ---"
ls "$t/dest" | grep tar.gz
echo "--- help ---"
bash rotate.sh --help | head -2
echo "--- bad keep ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown opt ---"
bash rotate.sh --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- missing dest ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/nope" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manual check of rotate.sh: deletes oldest, flags, error paths
Remove scratch check script and show changed files
Show changed files in the repository

result:
Done. (The sandbox declined `git status`; the final test run from the repo root shows `all tests passed` with both new tests included.)

Summary of the fixes:
- **rotate.sh** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which deleted everything *from* the keep-th line onward of the oldest-first list (i.e. the newest archives, triggered even at exactly N); it now deletes the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`), with the early exit changed to `-le` so exactly N archives means "nothing to rotate".
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar file name came from `awk '{print $2}'` (first word only) and was compared with unquoted `[ $expected == $actual ]`; it now takes everything after shasum's two-space separator (`${line#*  }`) and compares with quoted `[[ ... ]]`, keeping the malformed-sidecar detection working.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the shared option-parsing block (`is_uint`, `need_value`, the flag loop, the `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, sourced by rotate.sh and verify.sh; both keep all their flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`) and exit codes, verified against help/dry-run/error paths.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — one test per bug: rotate with exactly 3 archives and `--keep 3` deletes nothing and spares the newest; verify reports `ok` for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

Changed files: `lib/common.sh` (new), `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`.
